vibe: Authority, Clarity, Truth, Density. Brutalist but functional, optimized for retail POS environments.

colors.rationale: High-contrast, stark white and 10% grey with Klein Blue (Primary) and Signal Red (Destructive) for functional clarity. Avoids 'purple gradient AI-slop' completely.

rules: MUST use JetBrains Mono for all pricing (AUD $), SKUs, and data tables for rapid scanning.
Headings must use tight tracking. Labels must use wide tracking.
Never center headings by default. Left-align text for POS utility.
Use 'Grid Borders' style: 1px visible borders separating major UI zones.
Manager Dashboard: Strict grid hierarchy, dense spacing (p-4 to p-6).
POS Worker Screen: 65% left panel (Product Grid & Search), 35% right panel (Cart & Checkout). Must fill screen height.
Mobile App View: Stacked bento grid, highly touchable targets.

components.cards: Flat background, 1px solid border (border-border), no shadow. On hover: translate-y-[-2px] with crisp shadow.
components.buttons: Square or rounded-sm. Bold text. Primary buttons use Klein Blue (#2563EB). Secondary buttons use zinc-200. NO gradients.
components.inputs: Flat, 1px border. MUST have high-contrast focus rings (ring-2 ring-primary).
components.tables: Dense rows. No alternating background colors. 1px bottom border on rows.
components.charts: Shadcn charts using the primary/destructive colors. No complex 3D or gradients. Pure line/bar charts.

icons.instructions: Use standard lucide-react. Stroke width 2 or 2.5 for bold, legible icons.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover. Example: hover:bg-zinc-900 hover:text-white.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific properties, NOT 'all'. Example: transition-colors duration-200.
motion_and_interactions.animations: Minimal. Entrance fades only. Focus on instantaneous feedback for the POS system.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: APCA/WCAG AA compliant. High contrast mode ready.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute. E.g., data-testid='checkout-button'.

images_urls.description: Minimalist white architecture background for the auth screen.
Minimalist logo placeholder for 'Store Info' settings.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize React with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI.
Inject the provided hsl_variables into the :root scope of index.css.
Implement role-based routing (JWT). 'Worker' role strictly sees the POS interface.
Build the POS interface to be high-density: quick search, barcode input listener, and touchable grid for products.
Build the Manager Dashboard with dense, scannable data grids for Purchases, Expenses, and Sales.
Use JetBrains Mono everywhere a price or SKU is displayed.
Ensure 'data-testid' is added to all buttons, inputs, and tab triggers.
